hero.title: Hina-Yana: The Lesser Vehicle
hero.description: An essential school of early Buddhism emphasizing individual salvation and strict adherence to the original teachings of the Buddha.

sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
Core Philosophy

  • Emphasis on Arhat ideal (personal nirvana)
  • Strict adherence to Vinaya Pitaka
  • Pali as the liturgical language

Key Figures

  • The Buddha (as a teacher, not god)
  • Sthaviras (The Elders)
  • Upali (Master of Vinaya)

Mindmap Overview

  • Hina-yana (The Lesser Vehicle)
    • Origins: Sthaviravada school
    • Scriptural Base: Tripitaka (Pali Canon)
    • Key Doctrines:
      • Four Noble Truths
      • Eightfold Path
      • Non-theistic focus
FeatureHina-yanaMahayana
GoalArhatship (Self)Bodhisattva (All)
LanguagePaliSanskrit
Nature of BuddhaHistorical TeacherDivine Savior

mnemonics.title: Mnemonics & Tricks to Remember
mnemonics.description: Remember the core philosophy of Hina-yana.

items.title: S.I.P
items.decryption: Focus on Self-liberation, Individual effort, and Purity of original teachings.

traps.title: UPSC Common Exam Traps
items: Confusing Hina-yana with 'Theravada': While similar, Theravada is the only surviving Hina-yana school, not a distinct category.
Assuming Hina-yana worships idols: Actually, Hina-yana focuses on symbols (Bodhi tree, footprints) and resists Buddha-worship as a deity.
